objective: Remove confirmed end-to-end authentication defects before any bootstrap or OPPO AAB is accepted.

confirmedDefects.problem: The mobile HTTP close timeout can end before the backend function/provider chain, after the one-time attempt has already been consumed.
confirmedDefects.acceptance: One bounded end-to-end mobile operation timeout exceeds the backend maximum; response-body reads remain capped; timeout produces a sanitized retryable result.

confirmedDefects.problem: X and Instagram attempt stores accept nowMs equal to expiresAtMs.
confirmedDefects.acceptance: Both stores classify nowMs greater than or equal to expiresAtMs as expired with focused boundary tests.

confirmedDefects.problem: Every syntactically valid provider error is classified as user authorization denial.
confirmedDefects.acceptance: Only explicit user-denial codes map to cancellation; server/configuration provider errors map to provider failure and remain sanitized.

confirmedDefects.problem: A late verificationCompleted callback can sign Firebase in after codeSent or request timeout, without JourneySession authentication completion.
confirmedDefects.acceptance: Each phone request owns a generation; only one terminal callback may mutate/sign in; late callbacks after codeSent, timeout or a newer request are ignored.

confirmedDefects.problem: Meta deletion callbacks delete or unlink Firebase Auth identity only; application data erasure and durable deletion-status evidence are absent.
confirmedDefects.acceptance: A separately owned, schema-complete erasure transaction removes or anonymizes all user-owned product data, persists status by confirmation code, and is exercised by Facebook and Instagram callback tests.
